::: lede
I research competition law with a focus on digital market regulation — self-preferencing by platforms, adtech, and algorithmic conduct — across the Japanese, U.S., and EU jurisdictions.
:::
:::

[Selected Works](../publications/index.qmd) · [Projects](../projects/index.qmd) · [Blog](../blog/index.qmd) · [日本語](../index.qmd)

## Research interests

- Self-preferencing and exclusionary conduct by digital platforms
- Application of competition law to adtech markets
- Algorithmic collusion and predatory conduct
- The interface between ex-ante and ex-post regulation in digital markets
